summary: CRUCIBLE: TASK-010 complete — echo agent factory wires TaskPayload into LLM conversation, CLI updated, typecheck clean
CRUCIBLE: TASK-015 README complete — already satisfied all acceptance criteria (purpose, setup, env vars, CLI, exit codes, architecture, kill switches)
CRUCIBLE: Phase E complete — integration test runner covers all 4 exit scenarios (clean/budget/loop/TTL), checks exit codes + result.json, supports selective runs
SCUE: FE-Analysis-Viewer and FE-Live-Deck-Monitor specs — complete, both features built and shipping
SCUE: Research complete — 11 findings (waveform sources, DLP track ID, ANLZ formats, hardware topology, fingerprinting, bridge data strategy)
SCUE: FE-Analysis-Viewer (8 tasks) + FE-Live-Deck-Monitor (7 tasks) — all implemented, typechecks clean, 184 bridge/API tests pass
SCUE: M3 Cue Stream — ON HOLD per user preference. Unblocked technically (FE screens + research done) but deferred.
SCUE: M7 Event Detection research complete — two-pipeline architecture (percussive+tonal), detector workbench design, all 5 design decisions resolved, spec drafted

SCUE: M7 Event Detection — spec drafted, awaiting operator approval before implementation. 8 phases: framework, features, heuristic drums, risers/fallers, stabs, storage, RF classifier, training pipeline
Tinyshop: Designer session for UI tasks (TASK-011, 012, 013, 019) — App Shell, Dashboard, Launch Drawer, Welcome Screen
Tinyshop: Phase 1 Foundation — TASK-001 (scaffold), TASK-002 (types), TASK-003 (SQLite) — no designer dependency
Tinyshop: Phase 2 Backend — TASK-004 through TASK-010 (Artifact Engine, SSE, APIs, scanner)
Tinyshop: Phase 3 Frontend — TASK-011 through TASK-023 (UI components, launch flow, edge cases)
v1.9.2 improvement rollout: version alignment, template frontmatter normalization (13/13), scorecard schema, eval manifest update, protocol improvements backlog entries
Brought CRUCIBLE and Tinyshop pipeline infra into v1.9 spec: runs.jsonl, incidents.jsonl, evals/, trigger tables
Tinyshop: pipeline-agnostic manifest system — decoupled all v1.8-hardcoded roles, paths, parsing, scaffolding, and UI from pipeline version. Auto-detects v1.8 vs v1.9.
Live Deck Monitor: 2-deck real-time waveform with auto-scrolling cursor, composite key track resolution, full diagnostic metadata. Java bridge emits playback_position_ms via TimeFinder.
Runtime hardening: jq-free hooks (python3 JSON parsing), git-guard fails closed, state-snapshot.py produces valid JSON, pyproject.toml addopts disables ambient plugins
Assessment fidelity: index-conversations.py indexes 149 transcripts, assess.py sorts by mtime, computes reads_before_edit, reports sampled session IDs
Core pipeline evals: all SCUE tests behind scue_available skipif guard, trigger table test checks pipeline-only skills, convention tests skip when projects absent
Artifact bootstrap: runs.jsonl + incidents.jsonl + state-snapshot.json bootstrapped, TestRequiredArtifacts fails on missing (not skips), audit-run-record stop hook warns
Variant runner: experiment.py loads YAML configs, resolves solver by name, instantiates per-variant model/solver/budget/TTL, prints comparison table
Workspace benchmark tasks: fix-short-track-bpm and build-health-endpoint use inline fixture code with deterministic_fix_check and deterministic_endpoint_check scorers

Deterministic scoring: code_quality uses structural signals (has_code, has_types, has_test, is_minimal, no_any), efficiency uses char/tool/runtime counts. LLM judge is optional secondary via code_quality_llm()

Live pipeline runner: claude_code_with_skills solver loads CLAUDE.md + flow SKILL.md + domain skills as system prompt. bare_prompt solver provides control group. experiment.py comparison mode shows per-variant results
Doc cleanup: run-evals.sh labeled LEGACY with pytest pointer, manifest.md updated to v2.0 versions and actual test counts, CLAUDE.md updated to v2.1 with experiment framework section

Review cycle 2026-03-24: three-lens analysis (A: efficiency, B: quality, C: knowledge) across 25 sessions. Synthesized into 12 improvement candidates. Tier 1 implemented: LEARNINGS.md, SCUE component API ref, diagnostic-before-visual rule, fix-tracker threshold 2.

Pipeline hardening: 8-item improvement rollout — policy alignment (2-attempt cap), fix-attempt-tracker expansion (Write+reset+8 hook tests), task closure enforcement (audit hook + eval + 11 backfills), stale artifact removal, root/project learnings split, component API loading path, diagnostic-before-visual eval. 64 evals all green.

Section-based review system: 6 SCUE sections (bridge, analysis, strata, pipeline, server, frontend) defined by real dataflow boundaries. 1-page contracts, coupling map, parallelization rules, three-pass review skill, 9 boundary enforcement evals + file coverage. SYNTROPY archived. Siloing guidance added to CLAUDE.md, feature-flow, refactor-flow, and section-review skill (re-evaluate after session batches).
Review-cycle skill: encode the three-lens process, session selection, batching, and synthesis as a reusable skill in skills/review-cycle/SKILL.md
Edit() hygiene rule: add guidance to all 3 flow skills — if >3 sequential Edit() on same file, use Write() instead. Reduces edit-cycling anti-pattern (8/25 sessions).
Session scope guideline: add to all 3 flow skills — cap sessions at 1-2 objectives. Sessions with 4+ objectives consistently score 2-3/5 efficiency.
Phase handoff prompt template: formalize the handoff-prompt pattern (emergent in sessions 4,8,14) as a template in templates/phase-handoff.md

Token Dashboard: self-contained HTML visualization of token consumption & context usage across Claude Code sessions. Multi-session monitor view with toggle-on/off panels, recency/project filtering, burn rate + context fill + per-turn cost + tool breakdown charts. Compare tab for overlay curves. Projects tab for aggregate stats.

Task risk classifier: risk field in task schema, risk-classifier.sh PreToolUse hook (blocks high-risk source mutations without approved plan, infers risk from keywords), 6 hook tests, wired into settings.json for Edit+Write.
Blast radius scope check: PreToolUse hook cross-references Edit/Write paths against active task's section contract, blocks out-of-scope mutations. From human-oversight research.

Compound error budget: extend fix-attempt-tracker to count total tool calls per phase, checkpoint with operator when budget exhausted (7 steps medium-risk, 4 high-risk). From human-oversight research.
Pre-flight readiness checks: add mandatory checklist to flow skills — acceptance criteria, section assignment, risk level, baseline test run, no conflicting tasks. From human-oversight research.
Interrupt budget tracking: track AskUserQuestion calls and escalations in state snapshot, surface count in session summary. Observability first, caps later. From human-oversight research.
PR size guardrail: convention eval warns when commits exceed 200 LOC net changes, guidance in feature-flow to split at phase boundaries. From human-oversight research.
Trust calibration metrics: extend run record schema with operator_interventions, agent_escalations, auto_approved_phases, rework_count. Feed into assess.py trends. From human-oversight research.
Add YAML frontmatter to section-review SKILL.md (other 4 portfolio skills already had it).
Eval: TestAllSkillsHaveFrontmatter — 2 tests verifying frontmatter existence and name+description fields on all SKILL.md files.
Eval: TestNativeHooksSettingsValid — 3 tests: JSON validity, script existence, script executability for all hooks in settings.json.
Moved state-snapshot.py from Stop to SessionEnd event. Langfuse + audit stay on Stop.
Added [experiments] (inspect-ai, pyyaml) and [all] dependency profiles to pyproject.toml.
Added MIT LICENSE file to repo root.
Normalized Langfuse env var: assess.py now checks LANGFUSE_BASE_URL first (matching LEARNINGS.md), falls back to LANGFUSE_HOST. langfuse-trace.py already accepted both.
JSON schemas for tasks.jsonl, runs.jsonl, incidents.jsonl created in .agent/schemas/. Required fields, enums, and descriptions defined.
Eval: TestJsonlSchemaValidation — 3 tests validating tasks/runs/incidents against their JSON schemas (required fields + enum values).
CI workflows: ci.yml (evals on push/PR with concurrency), nightly-assess.yml (scheduled assess.py with Langfuse secrets), experiment.yml (manual workflow_dispatch).
Structured output: assess.py --out flag writes JSON report to caller-specified path. experiment.py --out deferred until Promptfoo migration (v2.2 P4).
CI sanity checks: python -m json.tool on settings.json + shellcheck on hook scripts, both in ci.yml workflow.
Artifact retention: 30 days for eval results, 90 days for nightly-assess trend data, 30 days for experiment results.
Risk-tiered oversight matrix: replace blanket human gates with selective ones based on risk+evidence+ambiguity. Add Oversight Policy section to CLAUDE.md. Update flow skills to use matrix.
Augment tf-027 pre-flight with ambiguity detection: flag task descriptions containing vague terms (improve, optimize, clean up, better) without quantified criteria. Guidance, not hard block.

Stop-the-line circuit breaker: halt session on regression signal (failures increase after fix), drift signal (modified files 2x+ plan estimate), error chain (3+ consecutive tool errors). Extend fix-attempt-tracker.

Three-loop control model added to CLAUDE.md: inner (fix-attempt-tracker, lint, tests), middle (section checks, plan-gate, risk classifier, spec approval), outer (assess.py, DORA metrics, calibration). Includes guidance on where new mechanisms belong.
Pipeline SLOs: define 4-5 metrics (completion rate, rework rate, escalation rate, test-gate failure rate) in templates/pipeline-slos.md. Wire into assess.py reporting.
Operator review latency tracking: add time_to_operator_response to run records. Surface in assess.py trends. Measure for 20+ sessions before setting SLO.
Eval flakiness budget: track per-test pass/fail in run records, flag tests failing >10% without code changes as flaky candidates, auto-rerun once before consuming fix-attempt.
Trigger table miss logging: log every unmatched trigger input to .agent/trigger-misses.jsonl. Prerequisite for v2.2 P6 (LLM fallback) — build dataset before building classifier.
ADR template (templates/adr.md) + 3 seed ADRs: ADR-001 single-agent-with-skills, ADR-002 file-based-artifact-coordination, ADR-003 sections-as-bounded-contexts.
Artifact taxonomy document: list every artifact type (tasks, runs, incidents, specs, plans, contracts, handoffs), schema ref, producer phase, consumer phase, validation method.
Standard abstain packet template: structured escalation format for AskUserQuestion — blocked_because, missing_evidence, recommended_safe_default, reply_with. Add to templates/handoff-packet.md.
Idempotency keys design for event-driven sessions: derive stable event_id from trigger payload, store in .agent/events.jsonl, skip duplicates. Design doc only — implement with automation Phase 1.
Extend skill frontmatter schema with optional inputs, outputs, success_criteria, failure_policy fields. Start with 3 flow skills (debug, feature, refactor). Machine-checkable success criteria.
Doctor/bootstrap script (scripts/doctor.py): validate Python version, .venv exists, env vars configured, portfolio repos present, standalone path available. Fresh-clone safety net.
Standalone experiment tasks: 2-3 tasks in tasks/standalone/ with inline fixtures, no project repo dependency. Smoke tests for experiment framework + CI-runnable validation.
Workspace setup docs: standalone vs portfolio mode, expected projects/ layout, which scripts require project repos, how to scaffold new projects. SETUP.md or README section.

Calibration review loop: quarterly template pulling assess.py stats, comparing actual distributions to thresholds (step budget, fix-attempt cap, PR size, flakiness), outputting tighten/loosen/keep recommendations to .agent/thresholds.json.
Portable hook runtime: remove hardcoded .venv/bin/python from hook invocation, add runtime assumption checks with graceful failure messages. Document Claude-only vs portable behavior.

Improvement loop formalization: standard triage flow for improvement-candidates.jsonl (accept/defer/reject/superseded), protocol review template, require eval coverage for every accepted protocol change.
Dependency/build-script integrity guardrail: detect high-risk file mutations (hooks, packaging, CI, release scripts) in PreToolUse, require stronger evidence for risky changes.

Section-review manager-worker pilot: parallel section review agents for Pass 1, boundary-review for Pass 2, integration for Pass 3. Benchmark bugs-per-token, boundary findings, rework, wall-clock vs baseline.

Context checkpointing research: prototype lightweight session knowledge capture — files read, decisions made, hypotheses formed, dead ends. Write to .agent/session-knowledge/ at session end. Exploratory.
